g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class B2 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 6.4 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: YES - all thk (P-No.5B, B31.3 Tbl 331.1.1) 705-770 C. NDE: 100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets; HB <= 241; 100 % PMI.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Pump suction: no pockets, header falls to pumps; eccentric reducers 12"x8" FLAT ON TOP; temporary straine
7. Pump nozzle 8" assumed (API 610 vendor data pending).
8. Draw turns west to clear BPA return riser and C-101 OH line drop.
9. Hot pump (345 C): spring support at first support off column; warm-up lines at pumps.
ISOMETRIC VIEW - NOT TO SCALE - DIMENSIONS IN mm, ELEVATIONS / COORDINATES IN m (PLANT GRID)
100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets;
CAT 1 - T > 300 C & NPS >= 6; T > 200 C & NPS >= 1
P / L BPA draw to pumps
FLANGE WN RF CL300 B16.5, bore STD, ASTM A182 F5
PIPE STD, BE, ASTM A335 P5 SMLS
ELBOW 90 LR, BW, STD, ASTM A234 WP5
TEE EQUAL, BW, STD, ASTM A234 WP5
REDUCER ECC, BW, STD, ASTM A234 WP5
FLANGE WN RF CL300 B16.5, bore SCH 40, ASTM A182 F5
ERECTION: GATE VALVE OS&Y CL300 RF, A217 C5, trim 5
GASKET SPW 321/graphite, inner+outer ring, CL300 B16.20
STUD BOLT SET (nuts) A193 B7 / A194 4, CL300
PIPE SUPPORTS (std. dwgs): guide x3, rest x3, spring x6
